A1.justification: Both 25-page PDFs describe Struct2D and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–E. Their equations, algorithm, seven tables, and twelve figures can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original GPT-o3 prompting experiments, instruction-tuning evaluations, ablations, and qualitative results, including grounding and captioning results in Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original prompting, instruction-tuning, ablation, and qualitative results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The BEV prompting procedure, filtered object marks, metadata, optional keyframe selection, and instruction tuning are unchanged. Equations 1–3 and Appendix A's Algorithm 1 retain the same procedures.

E1.justification: Training sources and all evaluated tasks remain unchanged: VSI-Bench, ScanQA, SQA3D, ScanRefer, Multi3DRefer, and Scan2Cap. PhyWorldBench is added only as a citation, not as an evaluated benchmark.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1, 3, 4, 6, and 7, including GPT4Scene and R1-Zero-VSI in their respective comparisons. Citation renumbering does not introduce new evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Both versions report the same 422-question GPT-o3 evaluation subset, model configurations, training budgets, input procedures, benchmark splits, and evaluation metrics. No reported experimental setting is revised.

E4.justification: The perception comparison, prompting-component ablations, QA-augmentation and reasoning-token analyses, and qualitative case studies are retained unchanged in Tables 1, 2, and 5 and Appendices A and D.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable uncertainty estimates. Both retain the same point-score reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 retain identical numerical results, including the 41.9 VSI-Bench average in Table 3 and 48.5 ScanRefer Acc@0.50 in Table 6. Qualitative outputs, rankings, and reported trends are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–3 and Appendix B's geometric constructions for directional and distance labels are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, propositions, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: structured 2D prompting, the 200K-pair Struct2D-Set, and competitive instruction-tuned spatial reasoning. Their scientific scope and strength are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of metadata, rotation, and reasoning supervision are unchanged. The discussions of evaluation-metric limitations, 3D preprocessing requirements, indoor-scene coverage, and broader impacts are also retained.

D1.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendix C retain the same implementation, preprocessing, hyperparameter, hardware, and training-time disclosures. The code URL and code/dataset release statements are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Gu et al. (2025), PhyWorldBench, as reference 26 in Section 2's video-related citation group. All 102 existing references are retained, and the surrounding research-positioning discussion is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short Acknowledgment section thanking Zhangyang Qi and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The main text and appendix prose and organization otherwise remain unchanged apart from citation numbering and spacing.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment block and additional reference cause limited bibliography reflow on pages 11–16. The scientific figures and tables retain their content, structure, and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 adds an acknowledgment and one related-work citation, but preserves the method, empirical evidence, analyses, limitations, and reproducibility information throughout the main text and appendices. These limited editorial additions do not establish a meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
